notes.title: Freestyle Update Hotfix 0.5.1
notes.content:
Finetuned the suspension, so now the sitting stance has the vanilla settings while the standing one has harder suspension to help aproaching ramps without crashing into them.

We're aware that the new Nvidia Drivers might cause some hickups wich are something that don't really depend on our end.
We will be investigating if there's something we can do about it!

Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: Freestyle Update Hotfix 0.5
notes.content:
- Tuned suspensions
- Fixed the jump animation playing when it wasn't supposed to

We are still working on replicating all the tricks into the multiplayer and rebalancing the multiplayer maps to have more space, paired with a voting screen at the end of each round!

Stay tuned and thanks for your patience!
If you have any issues please let us know in the official discord linked on our store page!

notes.title: Freestyle Update Hotfix 0.4
notes.content:
Oops! looks like the freestyle update broke the multiplayer!
This hotfix fixes that!

Expect some update soon (more or less) to hopefully bring the multiplayer out of its beta phase!

We will be working on:
- adding a map selection menu / voting screen
- making more space into multiplayer maps moving haybales more to the outside of the tracks
- replicating the trick system into it so you and your friends can crash into an obstacle with style
- hopefully add new maps

Sorry for the inconvenience!
We are just a small team of 3 developers and we are trying our best to get Carts of Glory to its full potential!

- replicating the trick system into it so you and your friends can crash into an obstacle with style

notes.title: Freestyle Gamemode Update!
notes.content:
- Added new Freestyle gamemode with 4 skateparks.
- Added 8 new Time attack tracks.
- Added 16 unlockable carts.
- Added Freestyle Tutorial.

- Added trick system.
- Added auto landing corrections for standing position.
- Rebalanced game progression for 32 maps.
- Last stance and camera used are now kept in memory for the duration of the game.
- Other generic fixes.

Notes:

Tricks require to be standing (click the left stick to change stance).

Known issues:

- In the tutorial maps for some reason tricks won't work unless you respawn at least once. That's getting fixed next week.
- Audio volumes need to be adjusted on some maps and some new features.

tags.feature: - Added new Freestyle gamemode with 4 skateparks.
- Added auto landing corrections for standing position.
- Last stance and camera used are now kept in memory for the duration of the game.

tags.bug: - In the tutorial maps for some reason tricks won't work unless you respawn at least once. That's getting fixed next week.

notes.title: Patch 01
notes.content:
Hi guys! 
Here's a little update adding some quality of life improvements and a couple of fixes.

[b]- Fixed the keys Q and E to allow keyboard users to bail out.
- Added Top 10 leaderboard accessible for each map by pressing Y on controller or E on keyboard.
- Added a news panel to the home menu that we will use for any communication.[/b]

On top of this we would like to thank you all from the bottom of our hearts for all the love and support you've been giving us! [b]We are a small team of just 3 friends with no publisher backing us up and this means the world to us! [/b]
Here's a little video showing our future plans for the game regarding 2024! Hope you'll like it!
We will do our best to meet the high expectations you guys have. 
[b]Our policy is no paid DLCs or microtransactions, so any future content will always be free of charge![/b]

Thank you and stay tuned!

[previewyoutube=F4b8zxYyzkg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Hotfix 01
notes.content:
-  The server doesn't accept Gamertags shorter than 3 digits. We are addressing the issue, meanwhile now it doesn't get stuck in the loading screen anymore.
- Fixed an error that was overwriting the save file if the player changed Gamertag on steam.
- Fixed emotes not working with keyboard, you can now use 1 and 2 to play them.
- Fixed the K key that was removing the UI wich was there for development purpuse.

We are monitoring other known issues, if you're having troubles with anything don't hesitate to send us a bug report here or on our discord server
https://discord.gg/sKmh9muFDJ

Thank you for your patience and sorry for any possible inconvenience.
